# Your first workshop
[textlink="Back to Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"]
[textlink="Tool controls (OOC)" link="CMUGuideIndustryTools"] · Right-click equipment → [bold]Help[/bold] for its instructions.
## 1. Make something from almost nothing
[bold]Right-click yourself → Craft.[/bold] Carry the ingredients in your hands or worn storage, plus any required tools. A missing recipe usually means missing materials or skills. Tools are kept after crafting.
If a crafting challenge opens, follow its mouse-control hint: click in the timing zone, hold/release to steer the slider, or follow the marked target. Performance can change material use or output. The recipe finder shows base quantities.
One plank makes two branches. Wooden digging tools last [bold]two uses[/bold]; stone ones last [bold]six[/bold]. Upgrade before your last shovel becomes a story.
## 2. Gather, then light up - Chop trees with an axe. Carry logs with both hands; saw them into planks. - Mine stone with a pickaxe; collect clay from the shallow layers. - Make a stone striker from two stones. Fuel a fire or furnace, then strike it to ignite. It can take more than one try.
## 3. Your first hot metal [bold]30 clay or stone → furnace. 10 clay → crucible.[/bold] Add fuel and bring tongs, a hammer and a mold. Continue to [textlink="From Ore to Metal" link="CMUGuideIndustryForge"].
## Try the starter recipes Select an item to reveal its ingredients. This is a shopping list; craft through your character's menu.
